lines.en: I grind forward step by step.
My steps land like hammers.
My plates clatter as I move.
I turn slowly, but truly.
Soil flattens where I pass.

lines.zh: 我肩上的铁疙瘩晃了晃。
lines.en: The iron mass on my shoulder sways.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，影子先罩住你。
lines.en: I lift a foot; my shadow covers you first.

lines.zh: 我把重心一点一点往前送。
lines.en: I edge my weight forward bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，停得也很少。
lines.en: I'm not fast, and I rarely stop.

lines.zh: 我站着，装甲缝里冒热气。
lines.en: I stand, heat venting from my seams.
I'm zero eight, the last of the batch.
I wait for the core to cool.

lines.zh: 我把护板盖上，遮住缺口。
lines.en: I close a plate over a gap.
I'm heavier than the earlier units.
All my sinks are open.
I listen to my own low-frequency hum.

lines.zh: 这台机体没写招式说明。
lines.en: No move list was written for this frame.
I don't breathe; I burn fuel.

lines.zh: 我在算几步能到你面前。
lines.en: I'm counting the steps to reach you.
My optic focuses slowly.
The cracks in the ground are mine.
I'd rather not move; moving heats me.
I close one fist.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不爱躲的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone who doesn't like dodging.

lines.zh: 我这台，被归在 Boss 里。
lines.en: This unit is classed among the bosses.
One fist of mine keeps you busy.
Two steps back isn't enough.
I've bracketed you in my sight.
Your armor is too thin.

lines.zh: 我看见你脚下的土在动。
lines.en: I see the soil shifting under you.
Raising your arm like that is brave.
My core is still warming up.

lines.zh: 你不必喊，没人拦得住我。
lines.en: No need to shout; no one can stop me.
I look down at you; my neck creaks.

lines.zh: 这台机体没有多余的话。
lines.en: This frame has no spare words.
A plate cracks open.
My core knocks; something's off.
I step back; the ground rings.
A new crater in my armor.
Still moving. Fine.
You got into a joint seam.
I hear the metal crying.
A steam line leaks.
Noted.
I don't eat. I burn fuel.
What you hold is too small.
Put it away; it's in the way.
That much energy won't fit my core.
My port isn't that kind.
Stop waving that by my feet.

lines.zh: 我要的是厚一点的东西。
lines.en: I want something heavier.
Coaxing a heavy frame?
Take it. I don't care.
My plating pushes you off.

lines.zh: 这一下对我来说像落尘。
lines.en: That felt like falling dust.
You need five steps to steady.
The ground under me sinks.
Don't press on my joints.
Plate on plate makes a deep sound.
Fix your stance before you try again.
I shift one step aside.
Again and I'll lean on you.
Another heavy is assembling too.
It's as heavy as I am.

lines.zh: 我们对了一下核心温度。
lines.en: We compared core temperatures.
Our serials differ by one.
Standing together, the ground sinks.
It guards my blind side.
We advance step by step.
No talk, only rhythm.
It halts; so do I.
Next activation, perhaps side by side.
I bend, plates clattering.

lines.zh: 地上那点东西，我捏起来。
lines.en: I pinch up what's on the ground.
The pearl goes into a seam.
I keep what falls.
I scrape it up with a nail.

lines.zh: 我手上还有上回的血印。
lines.en: Last time's bloodstain is still on my hand.
Into the side bin with it.
Done, I go on as before.
Not worth my trip.

lines.zh: 我把重心压下去，准备撞。
lines.en: I sink my weight, ready to ram.
You're dead center in my view.
Core warmed up.
I'm not yielding this one.
The ground under you goes first.
I raise an arm and the seams open.
You're at the stone wall. Good.
You're on my clearing list.
This frame doesn't rely on speed.
Best not to stand in front of me.
Locked on. The rest is walking.
You move first or I do; the result is the same.

lines.zh: 我的拳头已经抬到肩高。
lines.en: My fist is already at shoulder height.
I've calculated this distance.
You grip your sword; so I begin.
My optic locks on your knee.
Don't turn your back.
One stride crosses half the yard.
Listen: the ground is starting to ring.
Stay and I'll press you flat.
You run, I walk, and the gap holds.
My stride is longer than yours.
Behind the wall? Not high enough.

lines.zh: 我的装甲上全是你打的印。
lines.en: My plating is covered in your marks.
I don't go around. I push through.
The doorway's too narrow; I take it apart.
You've changed positions several times.
My core is still humming.

lines.zh: 你的箭落在我身上就掉。
lines.en: Your arrows strike and fall.
You're at the river. It isn't deep.
I keep heading your way.
I can count your steps.

lines.zh: 我把挡路的石堆推开了。
lines.en: I shove the rubble aside.
Dodging just circles you in place.

lines.zh: 我的护板落下，挡住你的箭。
lines.en: My plate drops and stops your arrow.
You have one corridor left.
I'm behind you. No shouting.
One step is all I need.
The ground rings under my weight.

lines.zh: 我这一拳砸下去，地裂了。
lines.en: My fist falls and the ground splits.
Plate meets you and you're thrown back.

lines.zh: 这一击用的是整台机体的重。
lines.en: That blow carried the whole frame's weight.
The weight pins your shield down.
My shoulder drives into your guard.

lines.zh: 你那条胳膊该抬不起来了。
lines.en: That arm shouldn't lift again soon.
I lift a foot onto your shadow.
That puts your back to the wall.
Heat vents from my seams.
I draw my fist back slowly.
A whole plate of your armor caves.
I'm in no hurry. I'll wait for you to rise.

lines.zh: 这一击让地面颤了一下。
lines.en: The ground shuddered at that hit.
The sword is knocked from your hand.
I've been pushed out of storage.

lines.zh: 装甲一落地，扬了半天灰。
lines.en: My plating lands and the dust hangs.
The core ignites. I'm moving.

lines.zh: 我从封存箱里翻了出来。
lines.en: I tumbled out of the storage crate.

lines.zh: 我的散热片一张开，热气腾腾。
lines.en: My sinks open and steam pours out.
The sky here sits too low.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，碾碎了脚下的砖。
lines.en: I lift a foot and crush the brick.
Someone threw the summoning switch.

lines.zh: 我先看了看四周有没有墙。
lines.en: First I check for walls.

lines.zh: 装甲上还挂着出厂时的油。
lines.en: Factory oil still clings to my plates.

lines.zh: 我的关节一节节卸下锁扣。
lines.en: My joints release their locks one by one.
I straighten up, wider than my kin.

lines.zh: 我的影子把门口全遮了。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole doorway.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，脚下的砖全碎。
lines.en: On landing, every brick under me cracks.

lines.zh: 这台机体很重，走起来费劲。
lines.en: This frame is heavy; walking costs me.
I hear voices in the wind.
My optic focuses twice.

lines.zh: 没有说明书，我照旧会打。
lines.en: No manual, but I still know how to fight.

lines.zh: 我把脚下的碎石扫到一边。
lines.en: I sweep the rubble from under me.
This much ground is enough for me.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的护板，只是发烫。
lines.en: Fire heats my plates. That's all it does.
On landing, my knees bottom out.

lines.zh: 水灌不进，可我在往底沉。
lines.en: Water can't get in, but I sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的护板掀开一角。
lines.en: The blast lifts a corner of my plate.
A round lodges in a seam.
Light gets into my core.
Fuel low; I slow.
Lightning skates across my armor.
I fall, and my core keeps humming.
